title: Ory's band at Coles Lawn and country dates
summary: The band played country towns and Coles Lawn, a pavilion with a woman owner who loved them; he also describes the ballpark lot at Third and Willow.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I've heard that you all played mostly with Oregon.

Well, most during that time, when Oregon really began to get to know. We used to play lots of time out in the country, you know. Every play there was St. John, Lake Charles, Donisonville, you know. We used to play over here. We had a place to play in, uh. There was Coles Lawn. Oh, we was there for years at Coles Lawn. Coles Lawn. Jackson, Will and Puff. Played Coles Lawn and played St. Couches. We played all over there. We just kept down at the Tulane University. Those boys, a lot. They got right popular around there. Can you tell us a bit more about Miss Coles Lawn parties, or what it was like? Yeah, yeah. She runs Saturday and Sunday, all holidays. And, uh, it used to be packed in there.
Uh, she was crazy about the band.

She always said if she'd ever die, she'd want that band to play at her funeral. Mm-hmm. And, uh, it used to be packed in there. Uh, she was crazy about the band. She always said if she'd ever die, she'd want that band to play at her funeral. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .

Did they charge to get in for those parties?
Oh yeah, fifty cents. Sure.
And when they danced, was it right on the ground?
No, in a big pavilion, in a hall, you know.
It started to build up then, like a hall. Yeah. Well, I thought it was a long party.

But you had a long party in the yard once. The long party used to be at Third and Woola, on the lot where the baseball team was. That's where long parties used to be. We used to have two bands sometimes playing out there. Right in that big lot, we used to play baseball. Third and Woola. They named it the National Park once. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, they fenced it in, you know. They had boxing, they had boxing there because Harry Wells and George Smith fought there. They had lawns right in there.

Yeah, she lived somewhere on the side there somewhere, back in there somewhere.
